requirements.text: Students should be able to view their checked-out materials and due dates online.
Students should be able to renew items online.
Students should receive reminders about due dates.
Students should be able to book study rooms online, selecting date, time, and number of people.
Library staff should have oversight to manage study room bookings and address issues.
The system should automatically calculate fines for overdue items.
The system should allow for manual checks for edge cases in fine calculations.
